_readme: Side Quest's quest pool. This file is the ONLY place quests live — edit it directly.

Each quest: id (permanent — never reuse or renumber; to retire one, delete it and add its id to _retired), text, category ('anywhere' | 'strangers' | 'unhinged'), level ('mild' | 'spicy' | 'unhinged').
The host's setup screen groups quests by category. 'unhinged' quests only appear when the party allows 18+ content.
To add one: append it to its group with the next unused number for its category-level.

categories.label: strangers
categories.hint: out in public, with people you don't know
